description: Evidence stub for 4h collaboration soak. Replace status with PASS after a successful run.

prerequisites: hbp-cloud API running (docker compose or kind install-hbp.sh)
run_instructions.command: export HBP_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 && export HBP_PROJECT_ID=<uuid> && export HBP_EMAIL=admin@dev.hbp HBP_PASSWORD=devpassword && python3 hbp-cloud/scripts/collaboration_soak.py --iterations 120 --interval-s 1 --log-file hb-platform/docs/ops/collaboration_soak_local.json
